core_obligations: Show alpha is a relative r-cycle on X/S if and only if i_* alpha is one on Y/S (proof lines 1069-1079). Since base change commutes with i_* by lemma-compatibilities (tag 0H4P), it suffices to prove: for S the spectrum of a DVR with generic point eta and closed point 0, sp_{X/S}(alpha_eta) = alpha_0 if and only if sp_{Y/S}(i_{eta,*} alpha_eta) = i_{0,*} alpha_0 (proof lines 1070-1074). This holds because i_{0,*} : Z_r(X_0) -> Z_r(Y_0) is injective (closed immersion into the fibre) and i_{0,*} sp_{X/S}(alpha_eta) = sp_{Y/S}(i_{eta,*} alpha_eta) by lemma-specialization-proper-pushforward (tag 0H4M) (proof lines 1075-1078).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the DVR case using commutation of base change with i_* (proof lines 1070-1074).
Injectivity of the pushforward on the closed fibre plus commutation of pushforward with the specialization map give the equivalence (proof lines 1075-1078).
